Andheri East, Mumbai

Professional Summary
Backend-focused software engineer with experience building and operating Go-based microservices for fintech and platform products. Proven track record delivering production services using containerization, orchestration, and RPC frameworks. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 90 days.

Technical Skills
Go, gRPC, K8s, Microservices, Docker, Confluence, Jira

Work Experience

Go Developer, Saffron Bank (Jun 2025 - Aug 2026)
- Implemented new Go-based microservices for payment reconciliation, using Docker containers and K8s for deployment; service processed 150k transactions/day with 99.95% availability.
- Designed and optimized inter-service communication patterns with gRPC stubs in Go, reducing end-to-end latency by 30% for critical flows.
- Introduced container image build pipelines and automated rollout strategies in K8s, cutting deployment time from 45 minutes to under 8 minutes.
- Collaborated with product and operations teams via Confluence and Jira to triage incidents and deliver two quarterly feature releases on schedule.

Backend Engineer, Zentrix Labs (Jan 2022 - May 2025)
- Built and maintained microservices in Go for a telemetry ingestion platform, scaling to handle bursts of 2000 reqs/sec using Dockerized services on K8s.
- Implemented gRPC-based streaming between collectors and processing services, improving throughput and reducing CPU usage per request by 25%.
- Led efforts to containerize legacy components and migrate them to K8s, enabling blue-green deployments and reducing rollback time.
- Documented service designs and runbooks in Confluence and managed sprint tasks and backlog in Jira.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
